1: Bells over the plaza, and the Black Iron Palace throwing its shadow across half of it.
2: Wind off the plateau, steady and cold. Below the cliffs the grass moves in long grey waves.
3: Zumfut's stump-houses sit under a canopy that never lets the hour through. Banners hang between the trunks.
4: Rovia has no streets, only canals. Everything that moves here is under oar.
5: Karluin's cathedral stands black against a sky that does not clear. The catacombs run under the whole floor.
9: Stachion's doors are locked with riddles, and the townspeople answer questions with questions.
10: Paper lanterns strung over a wet street. The marsh starts where the last house ends.
11: Taft's switchbacks climb out of the town and keep climbing. Frost sits in the shadow of every rock, and a mine mouth waits somewhere above the tree line.
13: Ash on the wind and a red line along the ridge. The rock underfoot is still warm.
20: The summit floor. Thin air, hard light, and a long way down on every side.
22: Low gold light through the trees above Coral Village. The lake is flat and the woods go quiet toward evening.
24: Panareze around its lake, shutters open and boats tied off along the front. Nobody here is in a hurry.
27: The trees close overhead and stay closed. Whatever is dug in under this canopy was dug in on purpose.
35: Mishe sits in soft hills under a spring sky. Somebody's grandfather keeps a house up on the Hill of Memories.
47: Floria. Flowers to the horizon in beds nobody planted, and nobody weeds.
48: Lindarth, at the bottom of an ice canyon. Snow comes sideways and a forge is going somewhere above the wind.
49: Myujen is white stone from the gate upward, and every wall of it throws the light back at you.
50: Algade does not close. Stalls three deep down the main street and somebody shouting a price over the top of them.
55: Granzam is iron all the way through. The Knights of the Blood keep their headquarters at the centre of it.
56: Pani is a clearing with a fence around it. Past the last post the trees start and do not stop.
57: Marten's trade road climbs between old walls. Caravans still take it, and still hire escorts.
59: The sandstorm does not stop here. It only changes direction.
61: Selmburg on its fog lake. The water starts somewhere out in the mist and nobody has said where it ends.
65: A live crater floor. Ashfall, obsidian underfoot, and heat coming up through the soles of your boots.
66: The geometry stops agreeing with itself. Distances here are a suggestion.
74: Collinia's grand plains, flat to the wall under a low grey sky. This is where the field bosses are fought.
75: Bone underfoot instead of stone, and a red gloom that has no source. The labyrinth here has a reputation.
76: Algade again, higher up and worse behaved. Dice under the awnings and an arena at the end of the strip.
80: Cloud-line air, and a sanctum floor that will not quite hold still. The stairs end where the geometry gives up.
85: The crater floor still shifts under the ash. Whatever was built up here has mostly gone back into it.
90: A garden with no ground. Things grow out of the air and turn to follow you.
95: The air is thinning. Cloud palaces hang above the path, lit from inside.
99: One floor below the top. Everything up here is gold and silence.
100: The Ruby Palace. Red light through red stone, and a throne at the end of it with someone already sitting there.
